Rhat (potential scale reduction factor) overview.

Source: R/plot_diagnostics.R
plot_rhat.Rd

One point per parameter; values close to 1 indicate the chains have converged to a common distribution. Values above 1.05 are a red flag.

Usage

plot_rhat(x, params = NULL)

Arguments

x

PEPI_Multirates object fit with fit_multirates().

params

Vector of Stan parameter base names to include. Defaults to every sampled parameter (excludes internal latent-state arrays and generated quantities).

Value

A ggplot object (see bayesplot::mcmc_rhat()).

Examples

# \donttest{
source(system.file("examples", "fit_example.R", package = "PEPI"))
